assets.prompt: Create ONE educational illustration, a separate cutout asset. Fine charcoal ink contours with restrained layered watercolour and realistic object/anatomy proportions. Match an editorial natural-history teaching collection. TRUE transparent alpha outside the object, no painted paper rectangle, no checkerboard. Keep roughly 12% clear transparent margins on every side. No people, human hands, human faces, brands or labels. Include text, numbers or arrows only if the individual asset brief explicitly requires them. Animal heads are essential where appropriate. Preserve the requested view and approximate aspect ratio. No cast shadow or floor unless explicitly requested. ASSET BRIEF: 1. `hms-knee-synovial-cutaway-v1.png` (1600 x 2000): a side (sagittal) cutaway of a right knee joint, slightly flexed: the lower end of the femur, the top of the tibia, the patella in front within its tendon, pale blue articular cartilage on each bone end, the joint capsule as a translucent sleeve, a slim synovial membrane lining, the cavity faintly tinted for fluid, the two crescent menisci between femur and tibia, the cruciate ligaments inside and a collateral ligament outside, one bursa in front below the patella. Bones end in clean cut planes above and below; no muscle bellies, no skin, no foot. No people, hands or faces anywhere in the image.
